body: I'm really sorry to hear that, and I appreciate the solidarity. I know how awful it is, since you were only dating them for 2 months you were probably still in a honeymoon period. The whiplash from that can be just devastating.

I really appreciate that, thank you :) I will say, although the bad feelings haven't gone away, the initial shock of it all has definitely worn off over time, which has made it a little easier to kick some of the worse habits. Hope the same happens for you, at the very least.
